left_margin_initials.description: A column of single-character *L0 paragraph initials in the left margin. Each is a single Voynichese glyph (s, d, q, s, o, l, k, r, s) that precedes a paragraph block. They are positioned approximately x≈55–90, staggered vertically through the folio. Each aligns with the =P0 line that begins its paragraph. These are not bisecting elements — they sit in the margin gutter.

paragraph_initial_flourish.description: A decorative calligraphic curl/loop above the first line of text, typical of section or chapter openers in the Voynich manuscript. Located at the very top-left of the text area.
